text: A little red hen found some seeds of wheat.
"Who will help me plant them?" she asked.
pages.alt: The little red hen holds wheat seeds

text: "Not I," said the dog.
"Not I," said the cat.
So the little red hen planted the seeds herself.
pages.alt: The dog and cat say no while the hen plants the seeds

text: The sun shone and the rain fell.
Soon the wheat grew tall and golden.
pages.alt: Tall golden wheat in the sun and rain

text: "Who will help me cut the wheat?" asked the hen.
"Not I," said the dog. "Not I," said the cat.
So she cut it herself.
pages.alt: The hen cuts the wheat while the dog and cat watch

text: The hen took the wheat to the mill to make flour.
Then she asked, "Who will help me bake the bread?"
"Not I," said the dog and the cat.
So the little red hen baked the bread herself.
It smelled warm and sweet.
pages.alt: Warm bread cooling on a table

text: "Who will help me eat it?" asked the hen.
"I will!" said the dog. "I will!" said the cat.
"You did not help," said the hen. "My chicks and I will eat it."
pages.alt: The hen and her chicks share the bread

text: The dog and the cat felt sorry.
Next time, they said, they would help right away.
pages.alt: The dog and cat feel sorry
